svg.title: Required Workflow vs Required Status Check
svg.desc: A team edits its own copy of a dependency-review workflow to always pass, so its required check goes green, while a ruleset-required workflow runs from the central repository and still blocks the vulnerable pull request.
svg.text: Required Workflow vs Required Status Check
A status check trusts the repo's own workflow; a ruleset runs the central file itself.
ORGANIZATION RULESET: REQUIRE WORKFLOWS TO PASS
